SELECT /* isry.couns.constt.chttmng.mapper.inqChacttListMapper.getTotalCount : 채팅내역 게시글 수 */ COUNT(*) FROM AYB200 AA , ( SELECT AVG(BB.RSPNS_CN) AS AVRG_DGSTFN_SCORE , AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO FROM AYE195 AA , ( SELECT INDEX_SN , TYPE_SE_NM , RSPNS_CN FROM AYE196 WHERE REGEXP_LIKE(RSPNS_CN, '[[:digit:]]+$') ) BB WHERE 1=1 AND BB.INDEX_SN = AA.INDEX_SN AND BB.TYPE_SE_NM = 'chat' /* 유형구분명 */ GROUP BY AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO ) BB WHERE 1=1 AND ( AA.DEL_YN != 'Y' OR AA.DEL_YN IS NULL ) AND BB.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO (+) = AA.CHRO_NO
AND AA.CHTT_TYPE_SE_CD = #{CHTT_TYPE_SE_CD} /* 채팅유형 조회 */
AND AA.CNTN_IP_ADDR = #{CNTN_IP_ADDR} /* 아이피 조회 */
AND C##RG.DEC_B64(AA.CNSLTNT_NM_ENCPT) LIKE '%' || #{CNSLTNT_NM_ENCPT} || '%'
AND ( AA.CLIENA_ID LIKE '%' || #{CLIENA_NM_ENCPT} || '%'
OR
C##RG.DEC_B64(AA.CLIENA_NM_ENCPT) LIKE '%' || #{CLIENA_NM_ENCPT} || '%' )
AND AA.FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND AA.FRST_REG_DT <= TO_DATE(#{END_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')+1
AND AA.SUPV_SLCTN_CASE_YN = #{SUPV_SLCTN_CASE_YN} /* 위기유형구분 조회 */
AND AA.PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD = #{PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD} /* 문제상태대분류 조회 */
AND AA.PROBM_STTS_MLSFC_SE_CD = #{PROBM_STTS_MLSFC_SE_CD} /* 문제상태중분류 조회 */
AND AA.PROBM_STTS_SCLAS_SE_CD = #{PROBM_STTS_SCLAS_SE_CD} /* 문제상태소분류 조회 */
AND AA.PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD = #{PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD} /* 문제원인대분류 조회 */
AND AA.PROBM_CAS_SCLAS_SE_CD = #{PROBM_CAS_SCLAS_SE_CD} /* 문제원인중분류 조회 */
AND AA.ETC_CN LIKE '%' || #{ETC_CN} || '%' /* 기타내용 조회 */
AND BB.AVRG_DGSTFN_SCORE >= #{AVRG_DGSTFN_SCORE_MIN} /* 상담만족도 최소점수 */ AND BB.AVRG_DGSTFN_SCORE <= #{AVRG_DGSTFN_SCORE_MAX} /* 상담만족도 최대점수 */

SELECT /* isry.couns.constt.chttmng.mapper.inqChacttListMapper.selectInqchacttList : 채팅내역 게시글 목록 */ AA.CHRO_NO AS CHRO_NO /* 채팅번호 */ , B1.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS CHTT_TYPE_SE_CD /* 채팅유형 */ , AA.CHTT_TYPE_SE_CD AS CHTT_TYPE_SE_NM /* 채팅유형 (CODE) */ , B2.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD /* 문제상태대분류 */ , TO_CHAR(DD.BRTH_YMD, 'YYYY') AS BRTH_Y /* 출생년도 */ , CC.CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD AS CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD /* 위기유형구분코드*/ , B3.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS CRISIS_TYPE_SE_NM /* 위기유형구분명 */ , AA.CNSLTNT_ID AS CNSLTNT_ID /* 상담원아이디 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(AA.CNSLTNT_NM_ENCPT) AS CNSLTNT_NM_ENCPT /* 상담원명 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(AA.CLIENA_NM_ENCPT) AS CLIENA_NM_ENCPT /* 내담자명 */ , AA.CLIENA_ID AS CLIENA_ID /* 내담자아이디 */ , TO_CHAR(AA.CHTT_BGNG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CHTT_BGNG_DT /* 채팅시작일자 */ , TO_CHAR(AA.CHTT_END_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CHTT_END_DT /* 채팅종료일자 */ , EE.AVRG_DGSTFN_SCORE AS CNSLTNT_SRVY_WRT_YN /* 설문결과점수 */ , COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTAL_COUNT , AA.PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD AS PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD /* 문제원인대분류 코드 */ , B4.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_NM /* 문제원인대분류 코드명 */ , DECODE(FF.CLIENA_ID , NULL , '' , 'Y') AS SPCLA_MNG_TRPR_YN /* 특별관리대상자 여부 */ , DECODE(AA.SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO , 'Y' , 'Y' , '') AS SUPV_SLCTN_CASE_YN /* 슈퍼비전선정사례여부 */ , DECODE(AA.SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO , NULL , '' , 'Y') AS SRVC_PVSN_RQST_YN /* 연계의뢰유무 */ , AA.PROBM_STTS_MLSFC_SE_CD AS PROBM_STTS_MLSFC_SE_CD /* 문제원인중분류 코드 */ , B5.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS PROBM_STTS_MLSFC_SE_NM /* 문제원인중분류 코드명 */ , CASE WHEN AA.CLIENA_DEL_YN = 'Y' THEN '[내담자삭제]' ELSE '' END AS CLIENA_DEL_YN /*내담자 삭제 여부 */ FROM AYB200 AA , SAC100 B1 , SAC100 B2 , SAC100 B3 , SAC100 B4 , SAC100 B5 , AYA110 CC /* 위기상담게시판 */ , SCA100 DD /* 종사자 */ /*수정시작*/
, ( SELECT AVG(BB.RSPNS_CN) AS AVRG_DGSTFN_SCORE , NVL(AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO, 0) AS BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO , NVL(AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD, '') AS BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD FROM AYE195 AA, AYE196 BB WHERE 1=1 AND BB.INDEX_SN = AA.INDEX_SN AND BB.TYPE_SE_NM = 'chat' /* 유형구분명 */ AND BB.QESITM_ESNTAL_NO < 11 GROUP BY AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO, AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD ) EE /* 설문점수 평균 */
/* 수정끝*/ , ( SELECT DISTINCT A.CLIENA_ID AS CLIENA_ID /* 내담자아이디 */ --, A.CNSLTNT_ID AS CNSLTNT_ID /* 상담원아이디 */ FROM AYB110 A /* 특별관리대상자 */ WHERE (A.DEL_YN != 'Y' OR A.DEL_YN IS NULL) GROUP BY A.CLIENA_ID, A.CNSLTNT_ID ) FF WHERE 1=1 AND ( AA.DEL_YN != 'Y' OR AA.DEL_YN IS NULL ) AND B1.CMMNS_CD_VALUE (+) = AA.CHTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND B1.CMMNS_CD_ID (+) = 'CHTT_TYPE_SE_CD' /* 채팅유형 코드ID */ AND B2.CMMNS_CD_VALUE (+) = AA.PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD AND B2.CMMNS_CD_ID (+) = 'PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD' /* 문제유형대분류 코드ID */ AND CC.CHRO_NO (+) = AA.CHRO_NO AND B3.CMMNS_CD_VALUE (+) = CC.CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD AND B3.CMMNS_CD_ID (+) = 'CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD' /* 위기유형구분 코드ID */ AND B4.CMMNS_CD_VALUE (+) = AA.PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD AND B4.CMMNS_CD_ID (+) = 'PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD' /* 문제원인대분류 코드ID*/ AND B5.CMMNS_CD_VALUE (+) = AA.PROBM_STTS_MLSFC_SE_CD AND B5.CMMNS_CD_ID (+) = 'PROBM_STTS_MLSFC_SE_CD' /* 문제상태중분류 코드ID*/ AND DD.INDV_IDNTFC_NO (+) = AA.CLIENA_ID AND EE.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO (+) = AA.CHRO_NO /* 채팅번호 */ AND FF.CLIENA_ID (+) = AA.CLIENA_ID /* 내담자아이디 */
AND AA.CHTT_TYPE_SE_CD = #{CHTT_TYPE_SE_CD} /* 채팅유형 조회 */
AND AA.CNTN_IP_ADDR = #{CNTN_IP_ADDR} /* 아이피 조회 */
AND C##RG.DEC_B64(AA.CNSLTNT_NM_ENCPT) LIKE '%' || #{CNSLTNT_NM_ENCPT} || '%'
AND ( AA.CLIENA_ID LIKE '%' || #{CLIENA_NM_ENCPT} || '%'
OR
C##RG.DEC_B64(AA.CLIENA_NM_ENCPT) LIKE '%' || #{CLIENA_NM_ENCPT} || '%' )
AND AA.CHTT_BGNG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND AA.CHTT_BGNG_DT < TO_DATE(#{END_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')+1
AND AA.SUPV_SLCTN_CASE_YN = #{SUPV_SLCTN_CASE_YN} /* 슈퍼비전선정사례 조회 */
AND AA.PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD = #{PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD} /* 문제상태대분류 조회 */
AND AA.PROBM_STTS_MLSFC_SE_CD = #{PROBM_STTS_MLSFC_SE_CD} /* 문제상태중분류 조회 */
AND AA.PROBM_STTS_SCLAS_SE_CD = #{PROBM_STTS_SCLAS_SE_CD} /* 문제상태소분류 조회 */
AND AA.PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD = #{PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD} /* 문제원인대분류 조회 */
AND AA.PROBM_CAS_SCLAS_SE_CD = #{PROBM_CAS_SCLAS_SE_CD} /* 문제원인중분류 조회 */
AND AA.ETC_CN = '%' || #{ETC_CN} || '%' /* 기타내용 조회 */
AND EE.AVRG_DGSTFN_SCORE >= #{AVRG_DGSTFN_SCORE_MIN} /* 상담만족도 최소점수 */
AND EE.AVRG_DGSTFN_SCORE <= #{AVRG_DGSTFN_SCORE_MAX} /* 상담만족도 최대점수 */
AND AA.PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD IS NULL
AND CC.CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD = #{CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD} /* 위기유형구분코드 조회 */
AND FF.CLIENA_ID IS NOT NULL /* 특별관리대상자 조회 */
AND AA.CNSLTNT_ID = #{CNSLTNT_ID} /* 상담원아이디 조회 */
AND AA.SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO IS NOT NULL /* 서비스 제공의뢰번호 */
ORDER BY AA.CHRO_NO DESC OFFSET #{START_IDX} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{ROW_COUNT} ROWS ONLY

/* * isry.couns.constt.chttmng.mapper.inqChacttListMapper.selectInqchacttDetail : 채팅내역 게시판 상세 */ SELECT AA.CHRO_NO AS CHRO_NO /* 채팅방번호 */ , AA.CHTT_TYPE_SE_CD AS CHTT_TYPE_SE_CD /* 채팅유형구분코드 */ , DECODE(AA.CNTN_IP_ADDR, 'systemNull', '', AA.CNTN_IP_ADDR) AS CNTN_IP_ADDR /* 아이피 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(AA.CLIENA_NM_ENCPT) AS CLIENA_NM_ENCPT /* 내담자명 */ , AA.CLIENA_ID AS CLIENA_ID /* 내담자아이디 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(AA.CNSLTNT_NM_ENCPT) AS CNSLTNT_NM_ENCPT /* 상담원명 */ , AA.CNSLTNT_ID AS CNSLTNT_ID /* 상담원아이디 */ , TO_CHAR(AA.CHTT_BGNG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CHTT_BGNG_DT /* 내담자 입장시간 */ , TO_CHAR(AA.CHTT_END_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CHTT_END_DT /* 내담자 퇴장시간 */ , TO_CHAR(AA.CHTT_DSCSN_BGNG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CHTT_DSCSN_BGNG_DT /* 채팅상담시작시간 */ , AA.CHTT_DSCSN_CN AS CHTT_DSCSN_CN /* 채팅내용 */ , DECODE(EE.CLIENA_ID, NULL, 'N', 'Y') AS SPCLA_MNG_TRPR_YN /* 특별관리대상자 여부 */ , DD.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS CRISIS_TYPE_SE_NM /* 위기유형구분명 */ , AA.SUPV_SLCTN_CASE_YN AS SUPV_SLCTN_CASE_YN /* 슈퍼비전선정사례 */ , AA.CHTT_MEMO_CN AS CHTT_MEMO_CN /* 채팅메모 */ , AA.SXDC_SE_CD AS SXDC_SE_CD /* 성별구분코드 */ , AA.ACBG_SE_CD AS ACBG_SE_CD /* 학력구분코드 */ , AA.GRADE_SE_CD AS GRADE_SE_CD /* 학년구분코드 */ , AA.GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD AS GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD /* 졸업상태구분코드 */ , AA.REAL_CONSTT_SE_CD AS REAL_CONSTT_SE_CD /* 실제상담자구분코드 */ , AA.REAL_CONSTT_ETC_CN AS REAL_CONSTT_ETC_CN /* 실제상담자기타내용 */ , AA.YNGBGS_SE_NO AS YNGBGS_SE_NO /* 청소년구분번호 */ , AA.PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD AS PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD /* 문제상태대분류 */ , AA.PROBM_STTS_MLSFC_SE_CD AS PROBM_STTS_MLSFC_SE_CD /* 문제상태중분류 */ , AA.PROBM_STTS_SCLAS_SE_CD AS PROBM_STTS_SCLAS_SE_CD /* 문제상태소분류 */ , AA.PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD AS PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD /* 문제원인대분류 */ , AA.PROBM_CAS_SCLAS_SE_CD AS PROBM_CAS_SCLAS_SE_CD /* 문제원인소분류 */ , AA.ETC_CN AS ETC_CN /* 문제상세 */ , AA.LINK_PRCS_SE_CN AS LINK_PRCS_SE_CN /* 연계처리구분내용 */ , AA.RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_CD AS RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_CD /* 접수의뢰경로구분코드 */ , ( SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 x WHERE x.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_CD' AND x.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = AA.RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_CD ) AS RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_NM /* 접수의뢰경로구분명 */ , AA.LINK_INST_NM AS LINK_INST_NM /* 연계기관명 */ , FF.INST_NM AS RCPT_INST_NM /* 연계접수기관명 */ FROM AYB200 AA /* 채팅이력 */ , AYA110 CC /* 위기상담게시판 */ , SAC100 DD /* 공통코드 값 */ , ( SELECT A.CLIENA_ID AS CLIENA_ID /* 내담자아이디 */ , A.CNSLTNT_ID AS CNSLTNT_ID /* 상담원아이디 */ FROM AYB110 A /* 특별관리대상자 */ WHERE (A.DEL_YN != 'Y' OR A.DEL_YN IS NULL) GROUP BY A.CLIENA_ID, A.CNSLTNT_ID ) EE , ( SELECT A.SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO AS SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO /* 서비스제공의뢰번호 */ , B.INST_NM AS INST_NM /* 접수기관명 */ FROM SEB400 A , SAA000 B WHERE A.RCPT_INST_NO = B.INST_NO ) FF WHERE AA.CHRO_NO = #{CHRO_NO} AND AA.CHRO_NO = CC.CHRO_NO(+) AND AA.CLIENA_ID = EE.CLIENA_ID(+) /* 내담자아이디 */ AND AA.SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO = FF.SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO(+) /* 서비스제공의뢰번호 */ AND CC.CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD = DD.CMMNS_CD_VALUE(+) /* 위기유형구분 코드ID */ AND 'CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD' = DD.CMMNS_CD_ID(+)

SELECT /* isry.couns.constt.chttmng.mapper.inqChacttListMapper.selectSulmun : 채팅내역 설문결과 */ CC.QESITM_ESNTAL_NO , CC.QESITM_CN , BB.RSPNS_CN FROM AYE195 AA , AYE196 BB , AYE197 CC WHERE 1=1 AND AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{CHRO_NO} AND BB.INDEX_SN = AA.INDEX_SN AND BB.TYPE_SE_NM = 'chat' /* 유형구분명 */ AND CC.QESITM_ESNTAL_NO = BB.QESITM_ESNTAL_NO AND CC.TYPE_SE_NM = BB.TYPE_SE_NM ORDER BY CC.QESITM_ESNTAL_NO
SELECT COUNT(CHRO_NO) FROM AYA110 WHERE 1=1 AND CHRO_NO = #{CHRO_NO}
SELECT COUNT(CHRO_NO) FROM AYA120 WHERE 1=1 AND CHRO_NO = #{CHRO_NO}
mapper.update: /* * isry.couns.constt.chttmng.mapper.inqChacttListMapper.updateChactt : 채팅내역 게시글수정 * 2023.04.18 수정 : 불필요한 컬럼 삭제 / 컬럼 추가 - Jeong.Won.Je */ UPDATE AYB200 SET CHTT_MEMO_CN = #{CHTT_MEMO_CN} /* 채팅메모내용 */ , SXDC_SE_CD = #{SXDC_SE_CD} /* 성별구분코드 */ , ACBG_SE_CD = #{ACBG_SE_CD} /* 학력구분코드 */ , GRADE_SE_CD = #{GRADE_SE_CD} /* 학년구분코드 */ , GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD = #{GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD} /* 졸업상태구분코드 */ , REAL_CONSTT_SE_CD = #{REAL_CONSTT_SE_CD} /* 실제상담자구분코드 */ , REAL_CONSTT_ETC_CN = #{REAL_CONSTT_ETC_CN} /* 실제상담자기타내용 */ , YNGBGS_SE_NO = #{YNGBGS_SE_NO} /* 청소년구분번호 */ , PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD = #{PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD} /* 문제상태대분류 */ , PROBM_STTS_MLSFC_SE_CD = #{PROBM_STTS_MLSFC_SE_CD} /* 문제상태중분류 */ , PROBM_STTS_SCLAS_SE_CD = #{PROBM_STTS_SCLAS_SE_CD} /* 문제상태소분류 */ , PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD = #{PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD} /* 문제원인대분류 */ , PROBM_CAS_SCLAS_SE_CD = #{PROBM_CAS_SCLAS_SE_CD} /* 문제원인소분류 */ , ETC_CN = #{ETC_CN} /* 문제상세 */ , LINK_PRCS_SE_CN = #{LINK_PRCS_SE_CN} /* 연계처리구분내용 */ , RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_CD = #{RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_CD} /* 접수의뢰경로구분코드 */ , LINK_INST_NM = #{LINK_INST_NM} /* 연계기관명 */ , LAST_MDFR_ID = #{LAST_MDFR_ID} , LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE WHERE CHRO_NO = #{CHRO_NO}

UPDATE /* isry.couns.constt.chttmng.mapper.inqChacttListMapper.deleteChactt : 채팅내역 게시글삭제 */ AYB200 SET DEL_YN = 'Y' , LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE , LAST_MDFR_ID = #{LAST_MDFR_ID} WHERE CHRO_NO = #{CHRO_NO}
mapper.insert: INSERT /* isry.couns.constt.chttmng.mapper.inqChacttListMapper.insertCrisisBoard : 채팅내역 위기유형저장 */ INTO AYA110 ( INDEX_SN /* 색인일련번호 */ , CHRO_NO /* 채팅방번호 */ , BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /* 채팅방번호 */ , CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD /* 위기유형구분 */ , FRST_RGTR_ID , FRST_REG_DT , LAST_MDFR_ID , LAST_MDFCN_DT , BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD ) VALUES ( ( SELECT NVL(MAX(INDEX_SN),0) +1 FROM AYA110 ) , #{CHRO_NO} , #{CHRO_NO} , #{CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD} , #{FRST_RGTR_ID} , SYSDATE , #{LAST_MDFR_ID} , SYSDATE /* , '24' */ , ( select CASE WHEN ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE5 = 'chat' THEN '24' WHEN ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE5 = 'mobile' THEN '91' ELSE NULL END from SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'CHTT_TYPE_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = #{CHTT_TYPE_SE_CD} ) )

INSERT /* isry.couns.constt.chttmng.mapper.inqChacttListMapper.insertCrisisPerson : 채팅내역 위기유형저장 */ INTO AYA120 ( INDEX_SN /* 색인일련번호 */ , CHRO_NO /* 채팅방번호 */ , BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO , CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD /* 위기유형구분 */ , CLIENA_ID /* 내담자아이디 */ , FRST_RGTR_ID , FRST_REG_DT , LAST_MDFR_ID , LAST_MDFCN_DT , BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD , CONSTT_ID ) VALUES ( ( SELECT NVL(MAX(INDEX_SN),0) +1 FROM AYA120 ) , #{CHRO_NO} , #{CHRO_NO} , #{CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD} , #{CLIENA_ID} , #{FRST_RGTR_ID} , SYSDATE , #{LAST_MDFR_ID} , SYSDATE /* , '24' */ , ( select CASE WHEN ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE5 = 'chat' THEN '24' WHEN ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE5 = 'mobile' THEN '91' ELSE NULL END from SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'CHTT_TYPE_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = #{CHTT_TYPE_SE_CD} ) , #{CNSLTNT_ID} )

MERGE /* isry.couns.constt.chttmng.mapper.InqChacttListMapper.insertSpcla : 특별관리대상자 게시글등록 */ INTO AYB110 AA USING ( SELECT #{CLIENA_ID} AS CLIENA_ID /* 내담자아이디 */ , #{CLIENA_NM_ENCPT} AS CLIENA_NM_ENCPT /* 내담자명 */ , #{CNSLTNT_ID} AS CNSLTNT_ID /* 상담사아이디 */ , #{FRST_RGTR_ID} AS FRST_RGTR_ID /* 최초등록자아이디 */ , #{LAST_MDFR_ID} AS LAST_MDFR_ID /* 최종수정자아이디 */ FROM DUAL ) BB ON ( AA.CLIENA_ID = BB.CLIENA_ID AND AA.CNSLTNT_ID = BB.CNSLTNT_ID AND ( AA.DEL_YN != 'Y' OR AA.DEL_YN IS NULL ) ) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( SPCLA_MNG_TRPR_SN /* 게시글번호 */ , CLIENA_ID /* 내담자아이디 */ , CLIENA_NM_ENCPT /* 내담자명 */ , CNSLTNT_ID /* 상담사아이디 */ , FRST_RGTR_ID /* 최초등록자아이디 */ , FRST_REG_DT /* 최초등록일시 */ , LAST_MDFR_ID /* 최종수정자아이디 */ , LAST_MDFCN_DT /* 최종수정일시 */ ) VALUES ( AYB110_SQ01.NEXTVAL /* 게시글번호 */ , #{CLIENA_ID} /* 내담자아이디 */ , #{CLIENA_NM_ENCPT} /* 내담자명 */ , #{CNSLTNT_ID} /* 상담사아이디 */ , #{FRST_RGTR_ID} /* 최초등록자아이디 */ , SYSDATE /* 최초등록일시 */ , #{LAST_MDFR_ID} /* 최종수정자아이디 */ , SYSDATE /* 최종수정일시 */ )
